$comment: Registered exemptions for META-DOCUMENTS: files whose job is to enumerate the
forbidden words. Scanning a prohibition list with the marketing ruleset produces
noise, and noise trains people to ignore the scanner — which is the real failure
mode. Every entry must carry a written reason and a review date.
scope: 'sections'  — markdown only: skip everything under the named headings,
until the next heading of the same or higher level.
linePatterns       — literal substrings; any line containing one is skipped.
Paths are relative to the repository root and use forward slashes.
Prefer inline copy-audit-ignore-start / copy-audit-ignore-end markers in the file
itself where the file's owner can add them; this registry exists for files owned
by another unit. Delete an entry as soon as the file carries its own markers.

exemptions.reason: This IS the ruleset. It must quote every banned term to define it.
Index to the ruleset; summarises the prohibitions in plain English.

exemptions.reason: The brand guide's own prohibition lists. These lines forbid the terms rather than claim them; flagging them is a false positive. Scoped to named sections and three named lines so the REST of the guide is still scanned in full. Owned by the brand unit — replace with inline copy-audit-ignore-start / -end markers when they next edit it, then delete this entry.
